name: Facet
text: Use a **collapsible left sidebar** for primary navigation and context. It keeps every tool and layer visible at a glance without cluttering the main view, improving speed and clarity. Trade-off: it takes up horizontal space, but the benefit of instant access outweighs the cost—users can collapse it when focused.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A collapsible sidebar still buries critical updates under layers of scroll—users won’t notice alerts if they’re buried in collapsed sections. Better: a thin, always-visible top strip for alerts paired with a collapsible sidebar for tools. Settle it with a usability test measuring missed alerts vs. speed gains.
